The migration in db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb creates the table but does not add an index on the host column (or a functional index on lower(host)). This means every embed authorization will do a full table scan. While this is a valid performance concern for a public request path (embed_controller.rb calls EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?), it's not a bug per se - the code will work correctly, just potentially slowly at scale. This is an important architectural/performance concern introduced by the diff.
